sections.title: Runtime and JVM
items: Managed Auto, G1GC, ZGC and Shenandoah garbage-collector profiles use one centralized launch policy.
Minimum/maximum heap, GC selection and additional JVM arguments stay synchronized with the effective Java launch.
Server CPU/RAM telemetry is sampled centrally at low frequency instead of repeatedly from WPF views.
Batch-script launches perform bounded startup-only Java child discovery so telemetry follows the Minecraft JVM.

sections.title: Network diagnostics
items: Added lightweight public TCP reachability checks with listener, firewall and NAT/CGNAT-oriented explanations.
Automatic probes are cached, deduplicated per runtime identity and ignore stale results after restart or port changes.
Effective Minecraft ports remain synchronized with external server.properties changes.

sections.title: Add-ons
items: Hardened Modrinth, Hangar and Spigot downloads with HTTPS-only trusted hosts, redirect limits and bounded payload sizes.
Added strict plugin/mod JAR and datapack ZIP validation, including root pack.mcmeta checks.
Added validated local datapack import and streaming atomic local imports.
Tracked add-on updates are rollback-safe and store provider, project, version, SHA-256, size and install timestamp metadata.
Spigot installs resolve a concrete Spiget version instead of tracking an ambiguous latest alias.
Restart-required state survives workspace navigation until the server reaches a stopped state.

sections.title: Lifecycle, configuration and backups
items: Workspace/server switching no longer silently discards unsaved configuration changes.
Server relocation coordinates with runtime filesystem ownership, resynchronizes the active workspace and restores metadata on rollback.
Editable configuration paths reject junction/symlink escapes and visual/raw saves use rollback-consistent metadata updates.
Backup create, restore and delete operations are serialized, path-confined and coordinated with runtime filesystem maintenance.
Restore validates arguments before locking, checks available disk capacity and cleans completed rollback staging.
UI/runtime observers are detached during ownership changes and disposed before runtime teardown.

sections.title: Desktop and UI reliability
items: Added a Community single-instance guard so duplicate launches activate the existing app instead of creating extra tray instances.
Hidden metric pages suspend updates and telemetry-only runtime changes avoid unnecessary dashboard, console and workspace refresh work.
Unsaved-configuration warnings use the shared localization catalog.

sections.title: Release integrity
items: Community versioning is centralized in Directory.Build.props at v0.7.0.
Installer/application publisher identity is aligned to dutu-dev - TuffNode.
The installer build fails closed on stale release text or metadata.
Release output includes the installer, SHA-256 sidecar, checksums.txt and a machine-readable release manifest.
The release manifest records version, tag, publisher, public repository, source revision, installer size and SHA-256.

sections.title: Product boundary
items: Community does not include Core-only Always-On Service, remote management, player tunneling, remote files, Blackbox, Predictive Failure, Surgical Restore or Player Time Machine.
